blurb: Agonic Brewing Co. is a local brewery in Rice Lake, Wisconsin, offering a variety of craft beers, rotating hard seltzers, canned craft sodas, and non-alcoholic options. The taproom welcomes families and dogs, with board games, books, and dog treats available. They host events such as comedy nights, Oktoberfest, and themed celebrations.
extraNote: Growlers can be filled only if they are Agonic Brewing Co. growlers; no outside growlers filled · Taproom at 17c E Messenger St, Rice Lake, WI
